feed.title: Home Depot vs. Walmart: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
feed.summary: This article compares Home Depot (HD) and Walmart (WMT) as investment opportunities in 2026, analyzing their business models, financial performance, risk profiles, and valuation metrics. feed.title: HCA CEO Sam Hazen: Mission must ‘earn’ community trust
feed.summary: HCA Healthcare CEO Sam Hazen addressed challenges at Mission Hospital, including staffing, patient flow, capacity, and community trust during a recent visit to Asheville. He acknowledged past shortcomings and outlined HCA's commitment to improving operations, expanding workforce, and rebuilding confidence by prioritizing patient care and employee satisfaction. Hazen emphasized that regaining trust requires earning it through transparent communication and continuous improvement, rather than simply asking for it.

feed.title: Xcel Energy's Day Of Service Brought St. Cloud Residents Together For Grounds Cleanup And Maintenance Work
feed.summary: Xcel Energy held its 16th Annual Day of Service in St. Cloud, bringing volunteers together to support the CentraCare Health Care Foundation. Volunteers performed various cleanup tasks at the Gorecki Guest House, including mulching, debris removal, gardening, and window washing. This event honors the victims and first responders of 9/11 and highlights Xcel Energy's ongoing commitment to community service, which saw over 2,900 participants contribute more than 8,900 hours last year.

feed.title: Boeing and engineers' union reach tentative contract agreement
feed.summary: Boeing and its engineering union, SPEEA, have reached a tentative four-year contract agreement, which includes higher general wage increases than a previously rejected offer. The deal, if approved by the 17,000 members, would provide a 10% wage raise initially, followed by 4% raises plus merit-based increases. This agreement is crucial for Boeing as SPEEA members are vital to certifying its 737 MAX 10 and 777-9 jets, both of which are significantly behind schedule.

feed.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Stock May Be Fully Valued After A 18% Gain
feed.summary: Microchip Technology (MCHP) has seen an 18% gain over the past year, but analyses suggest the stock is currently overvalued. Both Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) and Price-to-Earnings (P/E) ratio checks indicate that MCHP is trading at a premium compared to its intrinsic value and industry averages. Investors are paying a high price for its position in AI infrastructure and automotive electronics, raising questions about whether future cash flows can sustain this premium.

feed.title: WPP set to retain Coca-Cola global media account: Report
feed.summary: WPP is expected to retain Coca-Cola's global media, data, and technology business, despite losing the North America media account to Publicis Groupe in 2025. feed.title: Costco’s newest store is about to open in SoCal after years of litigation
feed.summary: A new Costco Wholesale store is set to open in Camarillo, Southern California, on October 30, following years of legal battles that delayed its development. The 160,000-square-foot warehouse will feature a food court, pharmacy, optical center, and a 32-pump gas station, offering a wider product selection than older branches. The city anticipates the store will boost the local economy, create jobs, and recapture retail sales from neighboring cities, despite some local concerns about increased traffic.
